_budgets.resource-summary:script:size: Total JavaScript the page downloads, in bytes. The API does not compress responses (a reverse proxy does), so this is the raw size of the bundle: about 330 kB when this budget was set, 400 kB allowed. Raise it deliberately, in the change that adds the weight.
_budgets.largest-contentful-paint: Median of three runs, in milliseconds, desktop preset on a CI runner.
_budgets.categories:accessibility: Minimum Lighthouse accessibility score, 0 to 1, median of three runs. The signed-out page is what is measured.
